prediction_text: Britain votes to Leave: the referendum of 23 June 2016 results in a vote to leave the European Union. On referendum day Uranus and Ceres conjunct at 23 degrees Aries — a rupture/nurture severance signature falling on the UK national charts (1066/1801/1922) — breaks the existing membership arrangement; the 'Stay' poll lead collapses among the many undecided voters and Leave wins.
timing_claim: Referendum day 23 June 2016 is the fixed coordinate; the prediction was firmed 22 Feb 2016 for that date.
basis: Mundane astrology on UK national charts: Uranus (sudden rupture, separation) conjunct Ceres at 23 Aries on the day itself signifies a break in the sustaining union; applied to the 1066/1801/1922 UK charts this is a severance transit, not a continuity one. Polls showing Stay ahead with vast 'not sure' numbers leave the undecided bloc to break with the rupture signature — toward Leave.
